name: Play-first: the MORABO loveseat with chaise along the stairs facing the play area, the biggest play floor on the STOENSE
notes:
Alternative, play-first: the sofa turned to face the play area along the railing, so the floor from the coffee table to the toy wall is Maddie's. Along the railing the largest MORABO with a chaise that fits is the loveseat and the chaise add-on (IKEA's "Sofa with chaise", three seats, 96 1/8"): the sofa and chaise, 111 7/8", would leave 25" off the top landing (F-40). No TV (F-65); the open side's walkway (y 143-173) stays clear (F-42).
The sofa (F-67, Andrew 2026-10-25: "a chaise, i.e. at least 3 seats", "empty space between like" the MORABO chaise add-on, "the largest sofa / sectional / chaise that can fit"): MORABO in Gunnared dark gray on 6 1/4" wood legs, the open base he linked, high enough for a robot vacuum. Its cover is fixed (vacuum and wipe, not washable); the same pieces in Grann/Bomstad leather wipe clean and hold no dust mites (F-66). Every sofa piece is delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22): Andrew can't tape the stairs before the move (2026-10-26, F-07), so the sofa is ordered after move-in day's tape and the beds go first; the largest box is the corner's frame, 78 1/2 x 36 3/4 x 20 1/4".
loveseat-1 MORABO loveseat, rot 270, x 36-72.25, y 46.875-112.25: along the railing's 36" strip (F-40), facing east toward the play area and the window's right half; its north end 40.9" from the heater face (F-33); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
chaise-1 MORABO chaise add-on, rot 270, x 36-98.25, y 112.25-143: at the loveseat's south end, its lounger pointing east along the walkway's edge (F-42); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
coffee-table-1 VALNÄS turned along the loveseat, x 88.25-116.625, y 51.75-98.25: 16" from the loveseat (F-39), 14" above the chaise's lounger.
wall-lamp-3 VARPTROSS (top), on the window wall at x 50-57: the group's lamp, on the wall so the top landing's exit keeps its floor (F-40); a soft glow (5.9 W), with the ceiling light for reading. plant-1 FEJKA at the chaise's foot, x 99-108, y 129-138, 0.75" past it, 30.75" below the VALNÄS and 5" off the walkway (until the final audit 2026-10-26 it stood above the loveseat's north end, in the top landing's exit, which it narrowed to 31" before its leaves).
rug-1 TIOKRONA turned, x 55.5-149.5, y 25-143: under the VALNÄS, the loveseat's front legs and the whole chaise, its south edge on the walkway's edge (moved 4.5" by the final audit 2026-10-26: the chaise's outer legs stood 4.5" off it); 19" off the heater face (F-33); STOPP FILT underlays. Jute takes no robot vacuum (its page: never a rotating brush), so a no-go zone or a washable flatweave (F-67).
Play area (F-61), as d staged it, now the room's biggest: rug-4 STOENSE pale green (x 170-237, y 48.5-142.5) with kids-table-1 LÄTT on it (x 180-204.75, y 92-110.9) and kid-chair-1 kid's POÄNG (x 212-234, y 124-142.5); toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD with the UPPLYST and a VARPTROSS reading light over it (final audit 2026-10-26); bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2 (30 1/8", anchored, F-21); toy-cabinet-1 BESTÅ with the FLISAT and the VARPTROSS; art-1 PJÄTTERYD, art-2 RÖDALM. The floor between the VALNÄS and the STOENSE (x 116.6-170) is play floor too.
Walkways: the open side's walkway (F-42); the top landing's exit, 40.9" between the heater face and the loveseat with nothing on that floor (F-40), and the route along the window, 45" or more beyond (F-30); every route here is 30" or more. Nowhere to set a cup from the chaise (the VALNÄS is 52" from its lounger): a clip-on arm tray, not in the catalog.
Not placed: the KIVIK sofa and ottoman (rejected or replaced, F-67); the MORABO armchair and ottoman (in c; here the floor is the play area's); the POÄNG; the TÅGARPs (a floor lamp by the window would narrow the top landing's exit, and right of the window it stood in front of the reading bench); the TV (F-65).
Stairs: beyond the left wall behind a railing (F-40), so the 36" strip along it (x 0-36) stays clear its whole length, landings included; the bottom landing opens onto the open side's walkway, the top one onto the floor along the window (F-30). Which end people step off is unknown.
Heater: clearances run from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces from y 12, upholstery from y 18 (F-33). It runs the whole window wall, so the GINSTMOTT panels must stay off it: hem them to end above it once its height is known, or hang blinds as the office does. Window: eyeballed on the top wall (assumed-position:window); nothing stands under it (F-38).
Power: outlets can only be on the window wall and the play wall, and where they are isn't recorded; the VARPTROSS on the window wall needs an outlet there, and the UPPLYST and VARPTROSS cords on the play wall run down it in covers.
Kid safety (F-21): no glass; the FLISAT book display stands on the 15" BESTÅ, 31" together, so fix it to the wall; the KALLAX 2x2 is anchored.
Extras: as d staged them (curtains, rod, cushion covers and inserts, throw, KALLAX drawer inserts, DRÖNA boxes, LÖVA canopy, STOPP FILT underlays x3).
Total $2,836.71, prices as of 2026-10-22 and 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 (those before today are price-stale, F-02). Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured, anchor-required, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Final audit 2026-10-26: the plant moved from the top landing's exit to the chaise's foot; the TIOKRONA moved 4.5" toward the window so the whole chaise stands on it; a second VARPTROSS over the reading bench is the play wall's reading light. The soundest of the five for routes: every one is 30" or more.
